question:
Select the correct spelling to fill in the blank.

I often fail to ______ remember someone’s name.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"accurately"** means in a way that is correct in all details; exactly. (सटीकता से)

 
 
• **Example: **The data was accurately recorded in the system.
 
 
 
• **"Accurately"** refers to doing something with precision and correctness. (सटीकता से)
 
 
• **Example: **She accurately predicted the outcome of the match.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Accuriately** (अशुद्ध): This is a misspelling of "accurately" and does not have a meaning.
 
• **Accuritally** (अशुद्ध): This is a misspelling of "accurately" and does not have a meaning.
 
• **Accusatively** (आरोपित रूप से): In an accusative manner; related to the accusative case in grammar.
 
 
• **Example:** The sentence was structured accusatively, focusing on the direct object.
